name: @gandazgul/caper-engine
description: A point-and-click adventure engine built on Phaser 3.

scripts.fmt: oxfmt mod.js src/ docs/ examples/starter/ README.md package.json
scripts.fmt:check: oxfmt --check mod.js src/ docs/ examples/starter/ README.md package.json
scripts.dts: bun run types && dts-bundle-generator -o mod.d.ts --project tsconfig.bundle.json --no-check types/mod.d.ts && bun scripts/fix-phaser-dts.ts
scripts.dts:check: bun run dts && git diff --exit-code mod.d.ts
scripts.ci: bun run lint && bun run fmt:check && bun run check && bun run dts:check && bun run test
